title: Water Items
description: Make water more than a liquid!
body:
# This is a Mod that turns water in tools and more!

And to craft the items you will need a water shard (by putting a water bucket in a -               crafting table).
    
With a water shard you can craft stuff such as the water sword or water pickaxe (etc..).


Im allways trya impove my code so if you find a bug let me know!
